For a while now in certain internet circles I have been seeing a rise in decorative Chocolate covered Oreos. This doesn't really fall into the baking category but bakers do offer these things for dessert table package deals.

Personally I don’t “get” this trend (like some people don’t “get” custom cakes lol) – Oreos are sweet enough, so why cover them in Chocolate?? I’ll be honest, I have purchased a few molds to try these things as I am yet to find anyone in my area that sells them – I made them only once for my family. Personally I find them WAY too sweet, others may not though. If someone wanted to order them, I certainly wouldn’t say no, I’d make them. I don’t think I have met anyone that has even really heard of them so I don’t expect orders any time soon – I may be wrong though.

Like anything, they do come with a custom price tag – which believe it or not can be more than what some people charge for a small basic cake!! I think it is a little nuts for a “cookie” but it is a “custom” product, that being said I do understand the price for a more detailed mold, several different Chocolate colors, sprinkles etc.

I broke down some prices – not including an hourly rate the maker would charge for their time – so don’t forget that would make the final total more – no one who is smart works at any job for free 😉

Standard Mold

Price breakdown – these are all prices I came across and didn’t include sale tax.

  • Family size package or Oreos (48 count) – $3.56 (89 cents per 12 Oreos)
  • Ghiradelli Chocolate chips (my favorite Chocolate) – $3.13
  • Basic Oreo mold (Etsy) – 99 cents
  • Total – $7.68

They are usually sold in batches of 12. So lets break this down for just one batch. Seeing as we now have the basic Oreo mold, we just need the ingredient costs.

  • 12 Oreos – 89 cents
  • Ghiradelli Chocolate chips (1 bag) – $3.13
  • Total – $4.02

What is so staggering about $4.02 to do 12 Chocolate covered Oreos you say? Nothing at all, IF you are doing them yourself. There is a learning curve though so be warned hahaha – Chocolate can be a tricky thing to work with (I learned that the hard way making cake pops), you need to get the temperature right, make sure it is all over the Mold/Oreo, no bubbles etc.

So I looked around the internet for some prices and I was honestly shocked. Most are factory produced, which has high overheads etc which drives up the price but damn 12 little Chocolate covered “cookies” can be expensive!!

The general cost online I found is this:

  • 12 covered Oreos – $29.99
  • Tax – $2.70
  • Shipping – $14.99
  • Total – $46.68

That is just short of $4 per chocolate covered Oreo!!

If anyone out there does make these, feel free to shine some insight into pricing, technique etc. I am always interested to learn more about newer things!
